BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning covenants, conditions, and restrictions of an airpark.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to covenants, conditions, and restrictions of an airpark; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Property owned by a city is not subject to existing covenants, conditions, and restrictions of an airpark that are more restrictive than the zoning ordinance in the city.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Property owned by a code city is not subject to existing covenants, conditions, and restrictions of an airpark that are more restrictive than the zoning ordinance in the code city.
